h1: Custom Direct to Film Sportswear for Teams and Events
metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Sportswear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film sportswear with vibrant, durable prints. Perfect for teams, events, and corporate uniforms at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film (DTF) printing creates vibrant, detailed graphics on sportswear without the stiff hand feel of traditional transfers. The process bonds ink directly into polyester, cotton, and blends, making it ideal for performance jerseys, team hoodies, and event staff shirts that need to hold up through repeated washes. DTF works especially well for full-color logos or photographic designs on dark fabrics, giving your custom sportswear a premium look without high minimums.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film sportswear featuring a full-color team logo on a black performance jersey
